fileTileset-width.label: Width
fileTileset-width.tip: Number of horizontal tiles in tileset (1 ~ 256)

fileTileset-height.label: Height
fileTileset-height.tip: Number of vertical tiles in tileset (1 ~ 256)

fileTileset-globalOffsetX.label: Tile Offset X
fileTileset-globalOffsetX.tip: Horizontal offset of tiles in scene

fileTileset-globalOffsetY.label: Tile Offset Y
fileTileset-globalOffsetY.tip: Vertical offset of tiles in scene

fileTileset-globalPriority.label: Tile Priority
fileTileset-globalPriority.tip:
Sorting priority of tiles when rendering on the object layer.
Tiles below always overlay those above.
Priority = -1: shift sort up by one tile.
Priority = 1: shift sort down by one tile.
